title: Periodic 8-layer quarter-wave stack for MWIR stopband
scientific_hypothesis: A periodic 4-pair ZnS/ZnSe quarter-wave stack centered on the MWIR band can achieve high LWIR transmission while suppressing MWIR thermal background, with minimal layer count reducing manufacturing complexity.
design_principle: Bragg reflector physics: alternating high/low index layers with quarter-wave optical thickness at the stopband center wavelength create constructive interference for reflection in the stopband (3000-5000 nm) while transmitting outside the stopband (8000-11000 nm).
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | Ge substrate (8 layers total, 4 alternating pairs)
design_variables: ZnS layer thickness (applied to all 4 ZnS layers)
ZnSe layer thickness (applied to all 4 ZnSe layers)
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band
Maintain smooth spectral response without sharp ripples in LWIR passband
manufacturing_considerations: ZnS and ZnSe have compatible thermal expansion for cryogenic operation
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
Fresnel reflection at air-film and film-substrate interfaces
expected_advantages: Low layer count reduces deposition time and stress accumulation
Periodic structure is well-understood and reproducible
Symmetric design may reduce polarization sensitivity
known_risks: 8 layers may not provide sufficient MWIR suppression depth
Quarter-wave design optimized for one wavelength may have limited bandwidth
ZnSe not in guaranteed material catalog may require local resolution
execution_request_english: Optimize a periodic 8-layer multilayer film on Ge (Icenogle) substrate with air incidence. Stack order: Air | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | ZnS | ZnSe (Querry) | Ge (Icenogle). Two design variables: thickness_ZnS applies to layers 1,3,5,7; thickness_ZnSe (Querry) applies to layers 2,4,6,8. Wavelength bands: 8000-11000 nm (maximize transmittance), 3000-5000 nm (minimize transmittance). Total layers fixed at 8. Materials: zns, ZnSe (Querry), Ge (Icenogle). Find thickness values that maximize LWIR transmission while suppressing MWIR.
